description: DemaConsulting.CanvasNet.Viewer is the library equivalent of the canvasnet command-line tool: it probes, renders, transforms, inspects, compares, and composes into contact sheets any file the CanvasNet format packages can read (SVG, PDF, PPTX, VSDX, OpenSCAD, Vega-Lite, Mermaid and raster images), with the same stable error codes, and lets SVG documents embed all of them with a safe, pluggable image resolver.
title: CanvasNet.Viewer
